run_vr_kitchen_simulation: run the pybullet VR kitchen simulation with shared memory or GUI connection and VR controller input
create_visual_shape_and_multibody: create a visual shape from an OBJ mesh file and attach it to a multibody with no collision
load_urdf_and_sdf_robots: load URDF and SDF robot models like PR2 gripper, KUKA arm, and WSG50 gripper into the simulation
create_joint_constraints: create fixed and gear joint constraints between robot links and change constraint parameters at runtime
sync_vr_controller_to_gripper: sync VR controller position and orientation to a PR2 gripper and control opening via analog trigger
